description: Every Team composer historical rosters, 2001-02 through the current NBA season. Depth order is ESPN core depth charts (starter PG–C, then backups) when ESPN publishes that team-season; otherwise Basketball-Reference games started within position. Camp, Exhibit, two-way, and end-of-bench names from ESPN’s current team roster (and BBR leftovers historically) sit after the depth units. Per-game PTS/REB/AST/STL/BLK are Basketball-Reference when that table exists; otherwise ESPN regular-season then preseason gamelog averages. Relocated franchises keep the current cell (SEA→OKC, NJN→BKN, CHH 2001-02→CHA).

2002-03.reason: No Charlotte NBA team in 2002-03 (Hornets moved to New Orleans; Bobcats started in 2004-05).

2003-04.reason: No Charlotte NBA team in 2003-04 (Hornets played in New Orleans; Bobcats started in 2004-05).

2001-02.reason: No New Orleans NBA team in 2001-02 (the Hornets still played in Charlotte).
